### SandboxFailure

```ts
type SandboxFailure =
  | SourceInvalid
  | GuestThrew
  | DeadlineExceeded
  | SandboxBusy
  | Cancelled
  | DispatchLost
  | SandboxCrashed
  | BadResponse
  | ResultTooLarge
  | ResultNotJson
  | CapabilityFailed
  | Unknown;
```

Closed error channel shared by sandbox adapters and the invocation owner.
